name: v2.28.2
body:
## What's Changed
* Bump shogo82148/actions-setup-mysql from 1.54.0 to 1.54.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2330
* Trivial `pyproject.toml` readability tweak by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2331
* Force transitive dependencies, to pass `uv audit` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2332
* Update some dependency pins which are no-ops by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2333
* Upgrade `yaspin` dependency to v3.5.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2334
* Upgrade `wcwidth` dependency to v0.9.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2335
* Upgrade `setuptools` optional dependency to v84.x.x by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2336
* Pin `prompt_toolkit` dependency to v3.0.53 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2337
* Let slow query alert happen before paged output by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2338
* Allow unquoted comma-containing favorite queries to be saved in `~/.myclirc` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2340
* Allow comma-containing init-commands in `~/.myclirc` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2341
* Update changelog for release v2.28.2 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2342


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.28.1...v2.28.2
